scenes.heading: Pricing social media management: retainers vs. project work

sents.d: Pricing social media management: retainers vs. project work
Most agencies settle on monthly retainers, but knowing the alternative helps you price confidently.

Monthly retainers (a flat fee for ongoing, defined scope of work each month) are the norm for social media management because the work itself is ongoing, not a one-time deliverable — this also gives both sides predictable planning.
Project-based pricing fits better for bounded work like a single campaign, a platform audit, or a one-time content strategy document, where the scope has a clear beginning and end.

Pricing retainers based on the number of platforms managed, posting frequency, and whether content creation (not just scheduling and community management) is included avoids the common mistake of underpricing based on time alone, since strategy and oversight time is easy to undercount.

take: Price retainers by platforms, frequency and content creation.
